reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is UI theming for DeepSeek Harness Web. It is presented as an Amadeus-inspired skin in the README and package metadata, with web-targeted skin bundle wiring (skin.json and patch). The available evidence shows its function is interface appearance customization rather than automation, integration, or data-processing workflows.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供外观定制的插件，可安装后应用 Amadeus 风格的皮肤，改变界面视觉样式与对话区域呈现。
summaries.en: This plugin customizes the appearance of DeepSeek Harness Web by applying an Amadeus-themed skin to the interface and conversation areas.

capabilities: Applies a static UI skin for DeepSeek Harness Web via shipped skin assets and patch configuration
Changes visual appearance of conversation/dialogue and input areas in the web interface
No declared external integrations, terminal/file automation, or execution capabilities are exposed in the manifest
